items.quote: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
items.claim: The text says the LORD gave these sacrificial laws to Moses at Mount Sinai, on the day he told the Israelites to bring their offerings, in the wilderness of Sinai. This is what the text says, not a proven historical fact.
items.object: Moses; the children of Israel to offer their oblations
items.mechanism: divine command passed on to Moses

items.quote: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
items.claim: The text lists what this body of law covers: burnt offerings, meat (grain) offerings, sin offerings, trespass offerings, consecrations, and peace offerings.
items.action: set out the law of the offerings
items.object: burnt, meat, sin, trespass offerings; consecrations; peace offerings
items.mechanism: a closing list summing up the sacrificial rules
